[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Beezrul Granf''' was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Colders Watch]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], his crew included [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Chessa Dohhenty]] and [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] [[Dirk Harkness]]. During a delivery to [[Kelada starport]], Dohhenty was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] due to her links to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and Harkness went on the run after killing the troopers in revenge.<ref name="CD" />
